title: What Mike Vrabel said about his viral challenge flag toss
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel intends to keep his challenge flag duties despite new NFL rule allowing delegation.
Vrabel's dramatic challenge flag toss during a preseason game against the Colts gained significant social media attention.
Vrabel's challenge led to a successful overturn, crediting the Patriots with a fumble recovery against the Colts.

title: 16 hospitalized after chemical incident at Mass. industrial worksite
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: 16 employees hospitalized after chemical incident at industrial site in Hudson, Massachusetts on Thursday morning.
Hudson Fire Department responded following a fire alarm, reporting dizziness and eye irritation among workers.
Firefighters from nearby towns provided mutual aid; a chemical process is suspected to have caused the illnesses.

title: 2 New England spots make NYT’s list of best Mexican restaurants
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Food Truck Paradise in New Haven, Connecticut, features 28 trucks offering diverse cuisines, including Mexican specialty drinks.
Tuxpan Taqueria in Central Falls, Rhode Island, is noted for its tacos, gorditas, and signature chicken Milanesa torta.
Both Food Truck Paradise and Tuxpan Taqueria were listed among the best U.S. Mexican restaurants by The New York Times.

title: Are tire rotations necessary for electric vehicles?
author: John Paul
bullets: EVs require regular tire rotations to maximize tread life due to increased weight and instant torque.
Regular tire rotations can help reduce noise and extend tire lifespan even if current wear appears even.
EV tire longevity may be shorter than gasoline vehicles due to low-rolling-resistance tires and their specific design characteristics.

title: Patriots place Terrell Jennings on IR, sign two more running backs
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots placed running back Terrell Jennings on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury, affecting depth chart competition.
New England signed running backs JaMychal Hasty and Hasan Haskins to fill backfield vacancies post-Jennings' IR listing.
Myles Montgomery, another running back competitor, is also on injured reserve; team opens preseason against Indianapolis.

title: Celtics release 2026-27 schedule: When will Jaylen Brown return to Boston?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Celtics kick off 2026-27 NBA season on Oct. 20 against Detroit Pistons with a 3 p.m. game.
Boston's home opener is on Oct. 23 against NBA champions New York Knicks at TD Garden.
Jaylen Brown returns to Boston with Philadelphia 76ers on Jan. 21, 2027, after being traded in July.

title: Payton Tolle pitches 8-inning gem as Red Sox end 5-game skid with 7-0 win over Blue Jays
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Rookie Payton Tolle pitched eight innings, allowing two hits, leading the Red Sox to a 7-0 win over the Blue Jays.
Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam and had an RBI single, contributing to the Red Sox's victory and ending their five-game losing streak.
Red Sox maintain AL wild-card berth position despite matching their worst losing streak of the season before defeating Toronto.

title: 7 takeaways from Patriots’ 13-13 tie with Colts in preseason opener
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Patriots forced four turnovers in their preseason tie against the Colts, including a standout performance from veterans on defense.
Kicker Andy Borregales struggled, missing three out of five field-goal attempts, including a crucial 49-yard attempt in the final seconds.
O-line depth concerns arose after Ben Brown's exit with a leg injury, necessitating potential roster adjustments before the season begins.

title: Cape Cod documentarian Mischa Richter creates a dreamy ode to Grateful Dead culture with ‘Summer Tour’
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Mischa Richter's documentary 'Summer Tour' follows two young Deadheads during Dead & Co's final tour in 2023.
The film explores Grateful Dead culture, capturing community, acceptance, and music's impact on American youth.
Chloë Sevigny co-produced the film, which screens in New England locations like Cape Cinema and United Theatre.

title: Tiffani Faison to close Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool’s Errand in the Fenway
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: Tiffani Faison will close her restaurants Sweet Cheeks Q and Fool's Errand in Fenway on November 24.
Faison cites unsustainable costs, such as high fuel charges and tariffs, as reasons for not renewing leases.
Faison's Big Heart Hospitality will try to relocate employees from the closed restaurants to other locations.
